svg.aria-label: Ferry.perKey: an idle key's input is sent at once; a busy key's inputs gather in its lane while its call is in flight and travel together in its next call, in order, one call per key at a time.
svg.text: ≤ 1 call in flight per key · batch size follows load · no timer
idle → sent at once, no queue
inputs that arrive while a key's call is in flight wait in its lane, in order, and leave together in its next call
